dataset_prior_consumption: Consumed by Search 004; reused for discovery only

hypothesis.execution: next-bar taker entry and taker exit after 32 bars
hypothesis.failure: price drift and round-trip friction exceed the received funding
hypothesis.horizon: through the next expected eight-hour settlement
hypothesis.mechanism: Two consecutive same-sign settled funding rates may indicate persistent demand to hold the paying side; taking the receiving side may collect the next settlement.
hypothesis.observable: two consecutive settled funding signs and the latest absolute settled rate

limitations: Current spread, rules and fee schedule are not historical time series
REST book is a collection snapshot, not historical queue depth
OHLCV volume is not aggressor-signed trade flow
Funding uses settlement rates and entry-notional approximation
reused consumed data is not fresh validation
only six forward days are evaluated
settled funding persistence does not reveal the next funding rate
current spread, fee and instrument rules are not historical snapshots
taker execution only; no queue or maker-fill inference
multiple_testing: one family, two thresholds; descriptive only, no inferential claim
selection: highest one-day base-cost mean net R; tie lower threshold
